description: Target takes damage over time while bleeding.
Target is set on fire, taking damage over time based on fire stacks. Dodge roll to deactivate.
Target gains frost stacks that slow and damage them.
After Frost stacks accumulate the target is frozen, stopping their movement and action.
Target is Marked by evil and takes higher critical damage from hits.
Target is poisoned and takes damage over time once enough poison stacks are added.
Target gains increased damage amplified by the number of stacks.
Target has lowered resistance to all status effects and damage.
